P1.claim: The published headline consensus value equals the arithmetic mean of its window, rounded to the nearest microgram, at the 2021 and 2023 revisions -- and NOT at the 2026 revision.

P2.claim: The three 'calculated' means printed by the CCM (-2.1, -7.2, -14.9 ug) reproduce exactly from the three published windows.
P2.found: CV2021: computed -2.1333 vs printed -2.1; CV2023: computed -7.2000 vs printed -7.2; CV2026: computed -14.9000 vs printed -14.9

P3.claim: Successive published headline values differ by exactly -5 ug at both steps: -2, -7, -12.

P4.claim: The underlying calculated means are NOT an arithmetic progression -- the second step is larger in magnitude than the first. The straight line is in the published series only.
P4.found: calculated steps = ['-5.0667', '-7.7000'] ug -- the published line is straight, the calculated one is not

P5.claim: Every KCRV in the series is higher (less negative) than the one before it, while the consensus value falls at every step. The two series run in opposite directions.
P5.found: KCRV steps ['3.6', '4.5'] all rising; consensus steps ['-5.07', '-7.70'] all falling

P6.claim: The whole of the fall is the exchange at the edge of the window: the change in the mean equals (value entering - value leaving)/3, exactly, at both steps.
P6.found: the change in the mean is exactly the edge exchange divided by three, at both steps

P7.claim: At both steps so far, the value leaving the window is a pre-comparison legacy input -- the artefact itself in 2023, the 2016 pilot study in 2026 -- and never a KCRV.
P7.found: CV2021->CV2023: International Prototype Kilogram (2014) left; CV2023->CV2026: Pilot Study Reference Value (2016) left

P8.claim: The K8.2024 KCRV reproduces as the inverse-variance-weighted mean of the nine included participants, within 0.1 ug of the published -10.7 ug, and its uncertainty within 0.1 ug of the published 6.4 ug.

P9.claim: The published chi-squared of 5.5 reproduces within 0.3 from the same table, summing over all ten participants with deviations taken from the KCRV. (Least confident of these; the report's eq. 9 sums i=1..10 for 9 degrees of freedom and I am not certain which ten.)

P10.claim: sqrt(sum of squared input uncertainties)/3 equals the 6.0 ug the 2020 report prints for the arithmetic mean -- confirming the formula -- and then FALLS at each later revision while the assigned uncertainty stays at exactly 20 ug.
P10.found: u(mean) = ['5.992', '5.274', '4.234']; assigned uncertainty constant at 20 ug throughout

P11.claim: Phase-3 exit criterion (d) -- |consensus value - most recent KCRV| < 5 ug -- is satisfied at the 2026 revision, on both the clamped and the unclamped value.
P11.found: clamped 1.300 ug, calculated 4.200 ug, threshold 5 ug

P12.claim: The clamp is not a one-off: rerunning the rule from the start with the limit switched OFF gives a different value today, and the difference is exactly the amount withheld in 2026.
P12.found: total withheld -2.9000 ug; 2026 clamp alone -2.9000 ug
